BTC.signal: At daily decision i,priorcompletedperpetualROC=C[i-1]/C[i-1-L]-1. Flat enterslong iff ROC>H,short iff ROC<-H. Inside or on entrybands,existinglong persists strictly while ROC>-E;existingshort persists strictly while ROC<E. Long exits at ROC<=-E;short exits at ROC>=E. Crossing opposite strict fullentryband closesold then opensopposite at00:01. E<=H,at exact +/-H no newentry. State is actualsignedquantity,no unpublishedprice/funding input.
BTC.execution: At next00:01nativeperpetualOPEN,if desired direction differs,close old signed position first then enter desired if nonzero. Same direction retains actual quantity,no daily resizing. Quantity for a new entry=floor(2000USDT/priorcompletedC/lot)*lot times direction,not sized from future OPEN,NAV or unpublished funding.
